name: v2
description: Around the V2 design: entries only with the trend of a higher timeframe, no DCA ladder, a real stop and a larger target. Varies which trend is used, how far the target and the stop sit, how long the bot pauses after a loss and whether the M15 force-close stays on.

trend_tf.note: entries only in the direction of this timeframe's trend (sign of its MACD signal line on the last closed bar); null = no trend filter

target_usd_per_unit.note: USD of basket profit per 0.01 lot at which the basket is closed (gold: the same move in price; BTC: x100)

stop_loss_usd_per_unit.note: USD of basket loss per 0.01 lot at which the basket is closed

loss_cooldown_s.note: pause after a losing basket, seconds; 0 = the live 5 minutes

force_close_enabled.note: true = the live exit when the M15 slope score turns against the basket stays on
